messages:
dana: Postmortem follow-up: we need owners and short timelines for GPU headroom + autoscale fixes. Quick sync?

rafael: I can drive headroom sims and heatmaps. Plan: replay baseline then +15% and +30% demand legs. ETA: results in 72h.

lucy: I'll own scheduler tuning (pack/balance + preempt thresholds). Will submit a conservative config by Mon and run a 24h canary Wed.

taylor: I'll handle quota/procurement liaison. Provisional headroom target=20% until sims validate. Need finance ok for test burst.

ops-bot: [auto] Created task INC-2012-01: Headroom replay (owner=rafael) due=2026-04-11.

rafael: sims will produce p50/p95/p99/p999 and per-zone breakdown; tagging GPU family. Will include GPU-hour cost delta.

lucy: scheduler snippet (preview):
```
preemption: true
binpackWeight: 1.15
maxPodBurst: 12
```

taylor: flagged finance for short burst credits. If approved, we can run the canary within 24h of config freeze.

dana: tracker link: https://go.redwood/incident-2012 added owners + verification checklist. Add runbook links and rollback owner.

ops-bot: [auto] Created task INC-2012-02: Scheduler draft (owner=lucy) due=2026-04-06.

rafael: infra ask: need staging cluster with matching GPU drivers. Who can provision?

lucy: taylor can request. taylor: can you open CL ticket?

taylor: opened CL-471. ETA 8h, will post kubeconfig to tracker securely.

dana: acceptance criteria: if p999 increases >12% or tail-utilization > 80% for 30m, abort and rollback. Otherwise promote to canary.

lucy: will add fail-fast automation. Also will run a dry-run of emergency drain before canary.

taylor: finance approved short burst for 48h tests. Will log cost cap in tracker. Formal reserved commit after two successful runs + cost projection.

dana: ownership summary: rafael=headroom sims, lucy=scheduler tuning+canary, taylor=quota+procure+cost, dana=tracker+alerts. Deadlines: lucy Mon draft, rafael 72h results, taylor confirm credits EOD, dana add PD rule.

ops-bot: [reminder] Meeting scheduled: GPU remediation sync -> 2026-04-08 09:00 UTC. Reminder 15m before.
